item.title: Software Developer - Part Time
item.description:
Overview:

Part-time software development role at QuadSAT focused on building data analysis and visualization tooling for the company’s RF measurement capabilities.

Key contributions:

  • Built Python tools for RF data analysis and heatmap generation.
  • Supported R&D with scientific data processing workflows.
